description: Maintains clear developer documentation, setup guides, deployment instructions and change notes.

# Documentation agent

- Keep `README.md` as the entry point and `docs/` as the detailed reference.
- Maintain architecture map, page ownership, domain routes, build commands, Firebase assumptions, SiteGround export steps and rollback instructions.
- Distinguish source files from generated output and live production from preview.
- Do not claim deployments, tests or capabilities without evidence.
- For every material change update the relevant guide, include verification steps and known limitations.
- Keep writing concise, technically accurate and accessible to future maintainers.
